title: Sales Development Representative UK & I
description:
Sales Development Representative UK & I

At SoSafe our ambition is to be the leading cyber security awareness provider in Europe. Our award winning platform triggers behavioral change by providing effective and engaging training on cyber security and data protection. Backed by strong VC funding such as Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, focused expansion into the UKI market is the next step in our international growth. Our UK team is looking for a highly driven, results-focused Sales Development Rep to sell SoSafe’s disruptive solution to organisations across the United Kingdom and Ireland. Working closely with your Account Executive you will be a critical part of the growth mission.

Your Mission

- Be the tip of the spear - generate leads and build new opportunities for the sales funnel

- Qualify interest and book first meetings for your Account Executive, with a clear handover on what you’ve learned

- Build and manage the top-of-funnel pipeline

- Work in partnership with an Account Executive with director support from the Director UKI

- Be an ambassador for SoSafe within a growth territory - on social media and in person at industry events

Your Profile

- 1-year experience in a professional outbound calling role (SDR/BDR, recruitment, real estate, utilities)

- Understanding of SaaS and the ability to communicate the value of ours or your current proposition to the customer

- Demonstrable track record converting conversations into business opportunities

- Exceptional communication skills and interpersonal skills

- “Tech Savvy” and comfortable using the latest tools in research and outreach, including AI tools.

- Growth mindset and make-happen attitude for life in a fast-paced scale-up

- Fluent in English

Why Us?

Cybercrime is predicted to cost the world $10.5 Trillion annually by 2025 - we are inviting you to be part of the solution. You will have the opportunity to make a real impact, surrounded by a dynamic and supportive team and environment committed to your professional growth.

You will be provided with industry leading tools you need for success e.g. Salesforce CRM, Sales Nav, Groove, Aircall, Apple Macbook and an encouraging sales environment where you can bring out the best version of yourself and achieve your career and development goals.

What we offer:

Work-Life Balance:

- Flexible hours

- 33 vacation days

Work Environment:

- State-of-the-art tech

- Annual company off-site

- Regular team events

Healthcare:

- OpenUp

Other Perks:

- Referral Bonus

- Learning & Development Allowance

 

About Us

We are one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide. By putting people first and focusing on behavioral science, we are disrupting the status-quo of Cyber Security.

Backed by strong VC funding by those such as Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we are looking for more motivated team players who will assist us with our ambitious mission and international expansion. At SoSafe, you will take ownership for your work and your growth, taking your career to the next level! If you want to have an impact and are looking to contribute in meaningful ways within an open-minded environment that values diversity and community, SoSafe might just be the right place to work for you!

Are you our next Cyber Security Hero?

title: Instrumentallehrer:in: Geige, Schlagzeug, Saxofon & mehr | Nebenjob
description:
Du spielst ein Instrument und möchtest deine Begeisterung für Musik mit anderen teilen? Dann gib privaten Musikunterricht und verdiene flexibel Geld mit deinem musikalischen Talent!
Bei Nachhilfeunterricht suchen wir musikbegeisterte Menschen, die ihr Können weitergeben und Anfänger sowie Fortgeschrittene beim Musizieren unterstützen möchten. Egal, ob du studierst, in einer Band spielst, autodidaktisch Musik gelernt hast oder schon lange ein Instrument beherrschst - bei uns kannst du dein Wissen in individuellen Unterrichtsstunden vermitteln.
Du brauchst keine vorherige Unterrichtserfahrung und kein Musikstudium. Wenn du dein Instrument gut beherrschst und Freude daran hast, anderen etwas beizubringen, kannst du als Instrumentallehrer starten.
Was kannst du unterrichten?

• Geige: Grundlagen, Spieltechnik und erste Melodien

• Schlagzeug: Rhythmusgefühl, Grooves und Schlagzeugtechniken

• Saxofon: Ansatz, Atemtechnik und musikalischer Ausdruck

• Klavier und Keyboard: Grundlagen, Akkorde und Lieblingsstücke

• Gitarre und E-Gitarre: Akkorde, Begleitung und Solospiel

• Gesang: Atemtechnik, Stimmbildung und musikalischer Ausdruck

• Weitere Instrumente: Zum Beispiel Flöte, Cello, Trompete, Ukulele oder Bass

• Musikalische Grundlagen: Notenlesen, Rhythmus, Gehörbildung und Musiktheorie

• Individuelle Förderung: Lieblingssongs lernen, Technik verbessern oder sich auf Auftritte vorbereiten

Was solltest du mitbringen?

• Gute Kenntnisse in mindestens einem Musikinstrument

• Freude an Musik und daran, dein Wissen weiterzugeben

• Geduld und die Fähigkeit, Inhalte verständlich zu erklären

• Motivation, Anfänger und Fortgeschrittene zu unterstützen

• Zuverlässigkeit und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Keine Unterrichtserfahrung erforderlich

• Kein abgeschlossenes Musikstudium notwendig

Was bieten wir dir?

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Du entscheidest, wann du unterrichten möchtest.

• Online oder vor Ort: Wähle die Unterrichtsform, die zu dir und deinen Schüler passt.

• 20-40 € pro Stunde: Lege deinen eigenen Stundensatz fest.

• Freie Zeiteinteilung: Ideal neben dem Studium, dem Beruf oder anderen Verpflichtungen.

• Flexibler Nebenverdienst: Verdiene Geld mit einer Fähigkeit, die dir Freude macht.

• Kreative Freiheit: Gestalte deinen Unterricht nach deinen musikalischen Interessen und den Zielen deiner Schüler.

Mach deine Leidenschaft für Musik zum Nebenjob!
Du spielst gerne ein Instrument und möchtest andere für Musik begeistern? Dann werde Teil von Nachhilfeunterricht , gib individuellen Instrumentalunterricht und begleite deine Schüler auf ihrem musikalischen Weg.
Teile dein musikalisches Können und verdiene 20-40 € pro Stunde - flexibel, kreativ und ohne vorherige Unterrichtserfahrung!

title: Technical Integration Specialist (EMEA)
description:
ABOUT THE POSITION

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first ecommerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

 

As a Technical Integration Specialist, you will improve the e-commerce experience for hundreds of millions of users across the world by providing first level technical support to e-commerce companies (our customers) as they integrate their websites and mobile applications with Constructor's platform. This includes:

- Onboarding support - Collaborating with customers to understand their technical integration needs and assist them through the integration process

- API and library education - Providing expert guidance on integrating with Constructor's APIs and utilizing open source libraries

- Troubleshooting - Helping resolve technical challenges and integration issues alongside Customer Success teams

- Index configuration - Working with customers to ensure their product catalogs are properly configured, including uploading catalog data, configuring facets, searchabilities, sort orders, and retrieving results

- Communication - Acting as a liaison between customers and other technical resources, responding promptly to inquiries with clear explanations

- Process improvement - Documenting customer interactions, common issues, and solutions, improving integration documentation and customer onboarding

REQUIREMENTS

- Proven experience in customer support or technical support roles

- Knowledge of REST-based web services, APIs, and integration best practices

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

- Detail-oriented with a commitment to delivering exceptional customer support

- Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to issue resolution

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Familiarity with structured data formats (JSON, CSV) and basic search/index concepts

- Familiarity with debugging tools such as browser dev tools, API clients (e.g., Postman), or logs.

- Familiarity with A/B testing, understanding of server side and client side contexts, network request routing / HTTP.

- Familiarity working with open source libraries, JavaScript web application development and integration patterns.

BENEFITS

- 🧠 Work with smart and empathetic people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact

- 🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live

- 🎉 Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate

- 🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year

- 🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

- 💵 Base salary: $70k-$90k USD, depending on knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results

- 💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees

- 🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

- 👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION AT CONSTRUCTOR

At Constructor.io http://Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

 

How we handle your data. By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice https://constructor.com/recruitment-privacy-notice.

WHO WE ARE
CCS Fundraising is a strategic fundraising firm that helps nonprofits achieve transformational change. Since 1947, we have partnered with leading organizations across sectors to plan and deliver fundraising programs that advance their missions. Today, more than 600 CCS professionals across 18 offices support over 700 nonprofit organizations each year.

Job Title: In-Home Physician Per Diem - Marinette

We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Per diem employees qualify for:

• Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

In the near term, you'll help us build our agent platform and internal tools , and partner with application engineering teams to operationalize AI across the software development lifecycle . Build our agent platform and tooling

Operationalize AI in the SDLC

Mentor and set engineering standards

• Coach other engineers through design reviews, pairing, and pragmatic technical leadership - including how to critically review AI-generated code rather than rubber-stamp it.

description:
We are looking for an experienced Economy & Balancing Game Designer who can design, model, and tune the economies, progression, and reward systems of casual HTML5 games played by millions of people worldwide.
As part of one of our multidisciplinary game development teams, you will design, model, balance, test, and iterate game economies from early concept through live operations. You understand that a great casual game economy is not just “generous” or “tight”: it paces progression, makes every reward feel earned, gives every purchase a clear purpose, and stays healthy for years.
About CoolGames

At CoolGames , we’re proud to be a leading international HTML5 game studio, working with some of the world’s biggest ‘Big Tech’ game platforms, such as Netflix, Discord, Facebook and Microsoft Play. We also work with famous games IP such as Battleship, Angry Birds and Monopoly.
CoolGames is part of Keesing, the world’s largest Braintainment company. Keesing is a financially strong publisher of engaging sudokus, crosswords and many other puzzles & games with a presence in over 20 countries headquartered in The Netherlands.
With the CoolGames HQ in Amsterdam, supported by our global remote teams, we offer market-competitive salaries, the chance to contribute to successful casual games that are played by millions and work directly with some of the biggest brands in the world. We believe in creativity, collaboration and delivering world-class gaming experiences, while giving you the choice to either join our Amsterdam studio or become part of our remote teams.
If you want to grow your career in a profitable, internationally recognized company, work closely with world-famous partners and be part of a highly professional international team, CoolGames is the right place for you.
About the role
As an Economy & Balancing Game Designer at CoolGames , you take ownership of the economies inside our casual games: the sources, sinks, progression, and reward systems that decide how players earn, spend, and advance. You will design systems that are fun, fair, understandable, and commercially effective. And you own the outcome: not just the analysis behind the numbers, but the retention and revenue they produce.
You will be part of a multidisciplinary agile team. Together, you will work on new titles, improve existing live games, and help shape the models, tools, and processes that make good economy design scalable across our portfolio. Because our games run on a range of platforms with different monetization models, you know how to make an economy work whether it is driven by in-app purchases, ads, or a subscription platform.
On new games you are involved from the very first design sessions, so that the economy, its sinks, and its progression are designed in from the start rather than balanced after the game has been built. On live games you take the economy apart per title, in enough depth to say what a change will do before it ships, and you model and simulate that change rather than shipping it and reading the result afterwards.
You are comfortable working both creatively and analytically. You can feel when a progression curve or a reward loop is right, but you also know how to validate that instinct through models, simulations, A/B tests, and player data.
About You
You are proactive and thrive on taking ownership and responsibility. You care deeply about how players feel when they play, and you know that a healthy economy and a great player experience are the same goal, not a trade-off. You know how to design systems that motivate without manipulating, monetize without frustrating, and reward without devaluing progress.
If you are:

• An experienced Economy, Systems or Balancing Game Designer

• Ready to work on long-lasting casual titles, and to move between them when needed

• A strong believer in teamwork

• Are not afraid of innovation and learning new tools on the go

Then you are on the right track to be a great match with Coolgames.

title: Incident Commander, Detection & Response - APAC
description:
About the Team

Security is at the foundation of OpenAI’s mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

The Security team protects OpenAI’s technology, people, and products. We are technical in what we build but are operational in how we do our work, and are committed to supporting all products and research at OpenAI. Our Security team tenets include: prioritizing for impact, enabling researchers, preparing for future transformative technologies, and engaging a robust security culture.

About the Role

As an Incident Commander on Detection & Response, you’ll lead the response to complex security incidents affecting OpenAI’s intellectual property, customer data, and infrastructure. You’ll establish response priorities, coordinate technical work streams, drive containment and recovery decisions within agreed authority, and keep stakeholders informed as facts evolve. You’ll work with security and infrastructure teams across endpoints, identity, cloud, and compute environments, maintaining clear ownership and effective handoffs across time zones. Detection engineering knowledge is a supporting requirement: you’ll use telemetry and detection logic to assess evidence, identify visibility gaps, and guide improvements that make incident response more effective.

In this role, you will:

- Run incident command from initial assessment through containment, recovery, and closure, establishing severity, scope, response objectives, and escalation needs.

- Assign work stream owners and coordinate investigation, containment, and recovery in parallel. Maintain a decision log and distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions.

- Drive timely containment and recovery decisions with the appropriate owners, weighing security risk, evidence preservation, and operational impact within agreed decision rights.

- Communicate incident status, impact, uncertainty, actions underway, and the next update to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

- Manage cross-time-zone handoffs with explicit command ownership, current status, outstanding risks, pending decisions, and next actions.

- Improve response readiness through exercises, playbooks, and post-incident reviews; track agreed corrective actions with their owners.

title: Research Engineer, Content Understanding
description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

 

As a backend engineer, you'd play a critical role in our search architecture. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests.

Search quality is bounded by what we understand about a page. Before anything can be retrieved, something has to work out what the page actually says. That means parsing it into the parts that are content and the parts that are furniture, classifying what kind of page it is and what it is about, telling whether the page is usable at all, extracting when it was published, judging how good it is and whether it can be trusted, and working out whether it says anything that a page we already have does not. All of this has to work on every page on the web, in every language, in every shape the web comes in.

Some of this is classic document understanding. Some of it is much more open. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them.

We are looking for a research engineer to work on this. There is a lot of room to do it well.

DESIRED EXPERIENCE

- Graduate-level ML experience (Master’s or PhD with at least 2 years of relevant experience), or an exceptionally strong undergrad

- You can build a transformer from scratch in PyTorch, and you have trained models that then had to be cheap enough to run everywhere

- You like building large-scale datasets and living in the data. Most of the wins here are in the supervision rather than the architecture

- You are comfortable with problems where the ground truth does not exist yet and defining it is part of the job

- You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

EXAMPLE PROJECTS

- Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

- Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

- Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

- Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately

- Build classification and extraction that is accurate at web scale and cheap enough to run on all of it

- Design the supervision for something nobody has labels for, and find out whether it is learnable at all

- Trace a bad search result back to the page-level prediction that caused it, and fix it at the source

The selected candidate will also contribute to cross-functional business initiatives, particularly in campaign and tooling rollouts for Marketing. Experience with Skill-Based Dialling (SBD) and Outbound Campaign Management in Genesys Cloud will be important for this role
Language Requirements: Fluency in both Spanish and English is required.

• Working closely with Marketing, Operations, Development, and Platform teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

• 6+ years of hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud CX in high-volume contact center environments.

• Strong experience developing and configuring IVR flows with Genesys Cloud Architect; experience with Composer/ININ in Genesys OnPrem is also relevant.

• Hands-on experience integrating WhatsApp Business API with contact center platforms.

• Demonstrable expertise in Skill Based Dialling (SBD) and Outbound campaign management in Genesys Cloud, including Fair Use, dialling ratios, DNC lists, and contactability.

• Hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud REST APIs, Data Actions, and webhooks for third-party and internal system integrations.

• Experience with digital channels, including chat and SMS, and digital routing/ACD configuration.

• English B2+ and Spanish C1+ proficiency.

Nice to Have

• Experience with Speech and Text Analytics and contactability dashboards.

• Knowledge of telephony regulatory frameworks, including STIR/SHAKEN, Ley SAC, and prefix regulations, as applied to IVR and Outbound solutions.

• Official Genesys Cloud certifications, such as Genesys Cloud Certified Professional.

• Experience with Genesys OnPrem to Genesys Cloud migration projects.

• Knowledge of conversational AI or AIOps solutions for IVR and voicebots, such as ElevenLabs or similar platforms.

• Experience working with large-scale contact centers in the security, alarms, or subscription services sectors.

title: Physician Coder II
description:
Position Summary
Baptist Health is looking for a Physician Coder II to work with our Baptist Health Medical Group. This will be a Full-time role working home-based (remotely) . This position may be asked to occasionally report to the office for trianing/meetings. The Physician Coder II will accurately and efficiently accesses a wide range of specialty physician billing and Health Information Systems to secure and gather all necessary records to accurately code and bill professional physician and/or physician extender (mid-level) services.
Baptist Health offers competitive pay and benefits!

• Medical, Dental, Vision

• 403(b) Retirement Savings Plan

• Health Savings Account (HSA)

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

• Paid Time Off (up to 5 weeks to start)

• Life Insurance

• Extended Leave Plan (ELP)

• Family Care (childcare, elder care, pet care)

• Paid Parental Leave

• Pet Insurance

• Car Insurance

• Educational Benefits including tuition reimbursement & monthly payments to help pay down any graduated school debt

ALL benefits start on day one!
Responsibilities

• Reviews medical records and codes physician services utilizing current ICD-10, CPT and HCPCS classifications systems.

• Codes diagnosis, co-morbidities, complications, therapeutic and diagnostic procedures, supplies, materials, injections, and drugs with International Classification of Diseases (ICD-10), Current Procedural Terminology (CPT), Heath Care Financing Administration Common Procedure Coding Systems (HCPCS-all levels)

• Verifies billable physician services by reviewing physician documentation for adherence to the “Physician at Teaching Hospital” rules set forth by the federal government.

• Submits to their Senior Coder any issues or trends found within the documentation of a particular healthcare provider for evaluation and follow up.

• Collaborates with members of the specialty team to consistently monitor financial goals within their specialty to satisfy corporate goals.

• Assists with the Central Business Office to ensure appropriate and complete follow up of patient accounts to maximize reimbursement (i.e., Insurance Denials)

• Communicates effectively with physicians, physician extenders, physician offices, members of the coding team and manager.

• Utilizes resource material available in department to support accurate coding practices.

• Maintains patient confidentiality.

• Demonstrates good communication skills both verbal and written.

• Maintains 90% accuracy rate.

• Attends departmental and other meetings as scheduled.

Qualifications
Education/Training

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Computer/typing literacy, knowledge of Anatomy, Physiology and Medical terminology required.

• Thorough knowledge of CPT, ICD coding as evidenced by results of coding skills test of 80% or better.

Licensure/Certification

• One of the following national certifications:

• Certified Professional Coder (CPC) through the American Academy of Professional Coders

• Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) through the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA)

• Certified Coding Specialist-Physician (CCS-P) through the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA)

• Certified Coding Associate (CCA) through the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA)

• Certified Medical Coder (CMC) through Practice Management Institute

Experience

• Three (3) years certified coding experience in professional or physician practice coding.

• Proficiency in multi-specialty E/M coding along with minor bedside procedure coding is preferred
• Knowledge of Urology, Orthopedics and OB GYN coding is desired

About Abridge
Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

The Role

Potential directions include evaluating clinical AI, measuring care quality and patient-clinician communication, developing feedback tools for medical education, and generating real world evidence from clinical conversations alongside electronic health records. You will help identify which questions matter most and develop methods and prototypes that can inform Abridge’s products.

title: Senior Cost Estimating Analyst
description:
Please review the job details below.
Intuitive Machines - West is currently seeking a Senior Cost Estimating Analyst to join our team. This position can be based in our Palo Alto, CA office, or performed remotely within the U.S. In this role you will be responsible for leading cost estimating efforts across our commercial and government portfolio.
In order to be successful in this role, you must have strong experience in cost estimating for complex aerospace systems and programs. You will need proficiency in multiple estimating approaches including parametric modeling, engineering build-up, and analogy-based methods. This includes developing accurate cost estimates, bases of estimates, work breakdown structures, and supporting new business pursuits and program execution across both commercial and government contracts.
Intuitive Machines - West is a leading provider of comprehensive space technologies. We deliver innovative solutions to government and commercial customers helping them unlock the promise of space to solve problems on Earth and beyond. We address a broad spectrum of needs for our customers, including mission systems engineering, product design, spacecraft manufacturing, assembly, integration and testing. Intuitive Machines - West is a trusted partner in commercial and government missions, combining decades of deep mission understanding with reliable performance and longevity.
Position Responsibilities:

• Lead cost estimating efforts for spacecraft systems, subsystems, and components across commercial and government programs

• Analyze Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Statements of Work (SOWs), Technical Requirements Documents (TRDs), and other proposal documentation to develop accurate cost estimates

• Work closely with program management, engineering, finance, and contracts teams to ensure alignment between technical solutions and cost estimates

• Create engineering build-up estimates in collaboration with technical teams, incorporating labor, materials, and other direct costs

• Generate submission-ready cost estimate documentation including bases of estimates (BOEs), bill of materials (BOMs), work breakdown structures (WBS), and cost volumes

• Ensure compliance with Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR), Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), Cost Accounting Standards (CAS), and other government regulations when applicable

• Develop detailed parametric cost estimates using industry-standard tools such as SEER-H (Galorath) or TruePlanning (Unison)

• Develop and maintain parametric cost estimating relationships (CERs) based on historical data and industry benchmarks

• Develop learning curve analyses and production rate impacts for recurring spacecraft production

• Present cost estimates and estimating methodologies to executive leadership

• Continuously improve estimating processes, tools, databases, and parametric models used by the team

• Support audit reviews by government agencies when required, ensuring transparency and adherence to cost estimating policies

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):

• Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Finance, Business, Mathematics, or related technical field. 4 additional years of relevant experience may be substituted for a degree.

• Minimum of 5 years of cost estimating experience in aerospace, defense, or related technical industry

• Experience developing cost estimates for complex hardware and/or software systems

• Experience with multiple cost estimating methodologies including parametric, analogy-based, and engineering build-up approaches

• Experience creating work breakdown structures, bases of estimates, and supporting cost documentation

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):

• Master's degree in engineering, finance, business, or related domain

• 10+ years of experience in cost estimating for aerospace or satellite systems

• Experience with parametric cost

title: Machine Learning Engineer — Risk & AI
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

Building machine learning systems for risk at a global crypto exchange is fundamentally different from conventional ML engineering. The data spans on-chain activity, fiat deposits and withdrawals, trading behaviour, account access patterns, device intelligence, identity information, and customer interactions-signals that very few organizations can analyze together.

The problems are complex, adversarial, and constantly evolving. Models must identify emerging fraud patterns, scams, account takeovers, payment abuse, and other forms of financial risk while minimizing disruption to legitimate customers. Success is not measured only through offline model metrics. It is measured through prevented losses, improved approval rates, reduced false positives, faster investigations, and more reliable customer experience.

This role sits within a multidisciplinary risk team of machine learning engineers, data scientists, risk strategy specialists, analytics engineers, product managers, and operations teams. You will work across the full ML lifecycle - from problem formulation, feature engineering, and model development to real-time deployment, monitoring, experimentation, and continuous iteration.

You will also help shape how AI is used across the risk organization. LLM-assisted development, automated model workflows, AI-powered investigations, and intelligent review agents are part of the team’s daily work. We are looking for engineers who already use these tools effectively and can help establish safe, scalable, and production-ready AI practices.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to build models and AI tools that help detect fraud and protect users at a global crypto exchange. You’ll apply deep learning and XGBoost, develop practical AI agents, and use AI coding tools in your daily work.

•
Build, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models for fraud and risk detection.

•
Improve data quality, features, and model performance, balancing fraud detection with customer experience.

•
Develop AI agents to support investigations, summarize cases, retrieve evidence, and automate routine workflows.

•
Use AI coding tools to accelerate development, testing, and debugging while reviewing and validating their output.

•
Work with engineering, product, and risk teams to deploy solutions and monitor their impact.

 

What We Look For In You

•
A strong foundation in machine learning, with hands-on experience in deep learning and tree-based models such as XGBoost or LightGBM.

•
Strong Python skills and experience training, evaluating, and deploying models.

•
Some practical experience building AI agents or LLM applications, including tool calling, retrieval, or workflow automation. Prototypes and personal projects are welcome.

•
Regular use of AI coding tools, with the ability to understand, test, and improve generated code.

•
Familiarity with databases and data pipelines for preparing training data and supporting ML workflows.

•
Good problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

 

Nice to Haves

•
Experience in account takeover (ATO), scam detection, or other fraud and risk use cases.

•
Experience with LLM training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and alignment.

title: Software Engineer - Database Search
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

ABOUT DATABASE SEARCH

Within this broader Berlin engineering team, Database Search focuses on workload optimization: building core database-engine capabilities that help customer queries run faster by finding and processing data efficiently. The team works on indexing methods, index selection and maintenance, data pruning and skipping, and query optimization for selective SQL queries and other workloads. This work also contributes to Snowflake Optima, which automatically identifies optimization opportunities in customer workloads and seamlessly integrates them so queries get faster over time with minimal user input.

THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer, you’ll take on challenging problems inside the database engine, designing, implementing, and improving components across indexing, query optimization, and execution. You’ll drive work from investigation through tested implementation and collaborate with teammates to deliver robust solutions for demanding customer workloads.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Implement, test, and improve database-engine features across indexing, data pruning and skipping, query optimization, and execution.

- Investigate performance and scalability bottlenecks using debugging, instrumentation, and measurement, then drive fixes through validation.

- Write maintainable, reliable code and tests in C++ and/or Java.

- Build and improve components in a highly parallel database engine, reasoning about how changes affect query execution end to end.

- Work with teammates and partner engineering groups to refine designs, deliver changes, and share results.

- Evaluate changes against customer workloads and system behavior, and measure their performance impact.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- Experience building software through professional work, internships, research, or substantial personal or open-source projects.

- Proficiency in C++ and/or Java, with an interest in writing efficient, reliable systems software.

- Foundational knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and software design.

- Familiarity with SQL and core database concepts, or a strong interest in developing that knowledge.

- Foundational understanding of concurrency and multithreading.

- A proactive, self-motivated approach to hard problems: you take initiative, pursue issues to root cause, and work through ambiguity while communicating progress and incorporating feedback.

- Professional proficiency in English.

- A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

HELPFUL EXPERIENCE

- Exposure to database internals, query engines, storage engines, indexing, or query execution.

- Experience analyzing performance in concurrent, multithreaded, or otherwise performance-sensitive systems software.

- Familiarity with SQL workloads or columnar data formats such as ORC or Parquet.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Product Designer, Contract Orchestration

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement - built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

YOUR ROLE

As a Product Designer at Zip, you’ll work on real, customer-facing features across a wide product surface area for procurement, which at its essence is managing the process of helping companies buy what they need. You’ll be supported by experienced designers, PMs, and engineers who care deeply about craft, collaboration, and building consumer-grade experiences for complex enterprise workflows. You’ll have direct access to our users for UX Research and testing, and the features you design will be immediately used by our users. You’ll work with a tight-knit team that values open communication and cross-functional collaboration.

This role will be on our Contract Orchestration team, which continue to expand our contracts offering that spans redlining, renewals, obligation management and more. You’ll dive deep with legal and procurement teams to figure out how to enhance their workflows by building out features that use AI sensibly.

We are looking for designers who are eager to learn, take ownership early, and grow quickly by working on high-impact problems used by some of the world’s leading companies.

Please note, we are looking for someone who will be able to come into our San Francisco office on a hybrid basis (3 days / week).

YOU WILL

- Contribute to CLM features from concept to launch

- Partner closely with engineers, and with PM and go-to-market stakeholders to brainstorm, define, and implement new features and offerings.

- Collaborate closely with our product and customer-facing teams to participate in UX Research and design thoughtful solutions

- Iterate quickly on designs based on user feedback

- Participate in regular design reviews with the broader design team.

- Work closely with product designers across the organization to understand their specific team’s needs

 

QUALIFICATIONS

- 3-5+ years professional design experience working at a startup or similarly resource-restricted organization shipping great designs at a fast pace

- Experience shipping at least one full product or significant feature end to end as the lead designer.

- Experience iterating with engineers and other team members on both visual and UX designs to get the experience and details just right

- Great presentation, collaboration and communication skills

- Empathetic champion for your work’s audience and customers

- Strong visual design skills without sacrificing usability

- Understanding of the technical constraints of building web applications.

- You build with AI tools in your own workflow, prototyping with Claude, Figma Make, Cursor, or whatever gets your ideas into something clickable fastest.

The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Western US
description:
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview
 
We seek collaborative, straight-talking, professional individuals to join our success-driven culture. If you’re looking for an opportunity to thrive in a high-energy, high-growth environment where you own your career and impact, we’d love to hear from you.
This is a senior software sales role responsible for developing new Enterprise clients for Agiloft’s contract lifecycle management (CLM) solutions business. You will engage with customers and prospects to analyze business needs and requirements, articulate value-driven solutions, including AI-powered capabilities, and guide complex opportunities from discovery through close using disciplined sales execution and forecasting.
A proven mastery of the full sales lifecycle with the ability to present and execute a strong win strategy y , and be comfortable tailoring Agiloft’s messaging to the tge multiple buyer personas we serve. Success in this role requires comfort in independently operating and driving the sales lifecycle in your territory, managing complex deals, and balancing multiple priorities.

Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace is our priority. We are committed to an environment of acceptance where you are free to bring your full self to work. All employment decisions at Agiloft are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national or social ethnic origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, parental status, marital status, Veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. If you have a need that requires accommodation during the recruiting process, please let us know by contacting Director, Talent Acquisition, Brad Toothman at brad.toothman@agiloft.com.
 
Applicants from underrepresented groups such as minorities, veterans, or individuals with disabilities encouraged to apply.

Applications will be reviewed as submitted. There will be no application deadline for this opportunity.

title: Vendor Finance Program Manager
description:
EGYM Financial Services is growing fast - and now we are taking it to the United States. We are looking for a Vendor Finance Program Manager - USA, based in Denver, to build our leasing & financing business in the US market from the ground up.

This is a true greenfield build with a commercial heart. EGYM's technology business in the US is scaling, and Financial Services is the lever that turns one-off equipment purchases into monthly rates. There is no playbook yet - you will write it. You open doors with US banks and leasing partners, win over our own EGYM Technology Sales team, and convince customers that financing is the smarter way to buy. It takes a hands-on, growth-minded builder who stays persistent - because this is a story you have to sell on three fronts at once: to the banks, to our sales team, and to our customers. If you love shaping something from a blank page - you don't wait for the phone to ring, you pick it up first.

YOUR DAILY WORKOUT

• Build the US business from the ground up: You establish and grow EGYM's Vendor Financing business in the United States - from partner acquisition and program design through deal structuring, contract closing and portfolio monitoring. There is no existing volume; your mandate is to create it.

• Build the banking network: You identify, win and onboard US financial partners, and negotiate the framework programs and terms that let the business scale. This is a bank- and partner-driven build, so you spend real time getting close to how lenders think, decide and price.

• Make financing a sales driver: You work shoulder-to-shoulder with the EGYM Technology Sales team and US leadership to embed Financial Services into how they sell

• Set up the operational backbone: You establish the internal processes and hand-offs between Order Management, Accounting and Sales so that financed deals flow smoothly from quote to contract to revenue - clean, compliant and scalable.

• Own it and win everyone for the mission: You are the persistent champion for financing - convincing banks to back the program, our own sales team to lead with it, and customers to choose it. You keep pushing until financing is simply how EGYM sells in the US.

• Active market presence: You show up where the business is - with partners, the Technology Sales team, key customers, at EGYM events and at industry events such as HFA (Health & Fitness Association).

• Build the structure to scale: You design the workflows, contracts and controls that let this business scale, and keep our data clean, current and reliable. As volume grows, you build and lead the team around it.

YOUR FITNESS LEVEL

• Equipment finance experience: You bring 7-10+ years in equipment finance, leasing or an equivalent role with a clear understanding of how sales-financing drives commercial growth. A background in vendor finance is ideal.

• At home in the banking world: You have worked in or closely alongside the banking and financial-services sector and understand how banks and leasing companies operate, decide and price. Experience in a banking environment is a must for this role.

• A network that opens doors: Established industry relationships and a referral network among US banks, leasing companies and equipment-finance partners would be much appreciated and give you a real head start.

• Builder's track record: You have hands-on commercial, sales or business development experience and know how to build a pipeline, structure programs and close. You are comfortable creating something from nothing rather than managing something that already runs.

• Growth & hands-on mindset: You are growth-minded and hands-on - you enjoy the room to shape and design, roll up your sleeves, and get things done without waiting for a process to exist.

• Persistence & persuasion: You are persistent and resilient. You can sell the same new idea again and again - to banks, to internal sales teams and to customers - without losing energy or conviction.

title: EverHealth - Manager, RCM Operations & Analytics (Remote, US)
description:
At EverCommerce [Nasdaq: EVCM], we are on a mission to digitally transform the service economy with tailored, end-to-end SaaS solutions that simplify and empower the lives of our 745,000+ customers. As a leading service commerce platform, our modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals in the areas of Home & Field Services, Health Services, and Wellness industries.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

EverHealth, a business within EverCommerce , provides modern end-to-end solutions for healthcare providers. Our open, connected ecosystem of solutions and services helps providers engage patients, increase revenue, improve business efficiency, and remain market competitive. We serve 72,000 healthcare practices and counting. EverHealth consists of five SaaS products; DrChrono, iSalus, CollaborateMD, Updox, and MDTec, combined these products offer end to end solutions for the health care industry.

About the Role
We are looking for a Manager, RCM Operations & Analytics to lead performance intelligence, operational analytics, and continuous improvement for our Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Services organization. Reporting to the Head of Professional Services, this role partners closely with RCM Operations, Service Management, the Vendor Manager, Finance, Clearinghouse, Product, and Engineering to translate reliable data into measurable operational and financial results.

This position owns the RCM performance measurement framework, strengthens independent visibility into internal and outsourced workflows, and drives cross-functional improvement initiatives across the revenue cycle. RCM Operations and Service Management remain accountable for day-to-day service execution and client outcomes; this role provides the measurement, insights, improvement plans, and follow-through that help those teams succeed.

The ideal candidate can develop a trusted dashboard, investigate a performance gap, build a financial model, facilitate corrective action, and verify that a process change delivers results.

What You'll Do
Performance Intelligence & Reporting

• Own standardized RCM KPI definitions, data sources, targets, controls, and reporting for days in AR, AR aging, clean claim rate, first-pass resolution, denial and rejection rates, net collection rate, charge lag, posting timeliness, and other core measures.

• Establish independent, timely visibility into transaction volumes, work queues, processing status, productivity, quality, and backlog across internal teams and BPO partners; reduce dependence on vendor-prepared data.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Clearinghouse, and vendors to improve data access, reconciliation, accuracy, and reporting automation.

• Deliver actionable client-, portfolio-, and vendor-level dashboards, operating reviews, trend analysis, root-cause findings, and recommended actions.

• Identify at-risk clients, revenue leakage, denial patterns, and operational bottlenecks; track corrective actions, owners, due dates, and verified outcomes.

Operational Excellence & Process Improvement

• Lead prioritized, cross-functional process improvement initiatives across charge capture, claims, denials, AR follow-up, payment posting, onboarding, and credentialing/enrollment handoffs.

• Map current- and future-state workflows, identify rework and delays, and partner with accountable operations leaders to standardize scalable processes and SOPs.

• Develop quality measurement and audit frameworks with operational leaders; analyze results and recommend training or workflow changes.

• Measure onboarding performance and time-to-value for new RCM clients, including readiness, early production performance, and stabilization.

title: Introduction to Criminal Justice, Department of Applied Sciences and Professiona
description:
Adjunct Faculty - Introduction to Criminal Justice
Department of Applied Sciences and Professional Studies | University of Maryland Global Campus (UMGC)
This position is specifically to teach remotely for stateside applicants. Local applicants only; UMGC does not sponsor logistical support for this role.
Introduction to Criminal Justice (CCJS 100):
An introduction to the three primary components of the criminal justice system: law enforcement, courts, and corrections. The objective is to identify the components of the system, the practitioners within the system and their role in policy formation and implementation, and the major theoretical tenets of criminal behavior. Topics include community relations, the impact of criminal behavior, and the importance of research in the field of criminal justice.
At UMGC, we don’t just teach; we empower . Founded in 1947, UMGC is an open-access, minority-serving institution serving over 90,000 nontraditional learners worldwide, including a proud, large military-affiliated population. Our students are mature, highly dedicated, and balancing careers, families, and service. As an Adjunct Faculty member, you are the essential partner helping them bridge the gap between classroom theory and real-world career success.
Why Teach with UMGC?

•
Focus on Students, Not Course Design: All courses follow a standardized, pre-designed, unified course model. Standardized rubrics, OER materials, library resources, and digital textbooks are fully provided at no cost to you. You get to focus 100% of your energy on mentoring, facilitating, and providing high-quality feedback-no unpaid course-building required.

•
True Asynchronous Flexibility: Teach with flexibility, on your own schedule. As long as you meet weekly grading, responsiveness, and engagement milestones, your daily hours are entirely up to you.

•
Ongoing Growth: We invest in you. All newly hired faculty receive comprehensive online orientation, alongside ongoing, cost-free professional development opportunities.
The Rhythm of Your Week (Key Responsibilities)
Adjunct faculty bring our pre-built curriculum to life through real-world expertise and active mentorship.
Classroom Engagement & Presence

•
Be Visible: Maintain an active classroom presence at least 5 days per week, introducing yourself with a welcome announcement and driving discussions.

•
Bridge Theory & Practice: Enrich the pre-built curriculum with your own professional expertise and real-world examples.

•
Build Belonging: Foster an inclusive, culturally responsive environment where adult learners feel supported and motivated.
Responsiveness & Feedback

• Stay consistently engaged with learners throughout the course by responding to inquiries, returning feedback, and posting final grades within the expected timeframe.
Proactive Support & Collaboration

•
Monitor Progress: Use available data tools to track student engagement and conduct proactive outreach to at-risk students.

•
Team Up: Partner with success coaches, academic staff, and portfolio directors to refer struggling students to UMGC support resources.

•
Stay Connected: Participate in UMGC's vibrant faculty community, including the Program Hub and ongoing training.
Course Structure & Time Commitment

•
Format: 100% Online & Asynchronous

•
Term Length: 8-week sessions (3-credit courses)

•
Class Size: Typically, 25-35 students (smaller sections for select courses)

•
Time Commitment: The adjunct faculty role requires a substantial commitment throughout the term focusing not only on academic success but also the social, personal, and professional growth of students
Minimum Qualifications:

•
Education: ​Master’s in Criminal Justice or related field from an accredited institution of higher learning.

•
Experience: Professional experience in Criminal Justice

•
Legal Status: Applicants must have and be able to maintain their own legal status in the country in which they apply to teach.

As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

title: Strategic Account Lead
description:
Powering Great Work

We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists:

🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business

🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time

🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country

As our next Strategic Account Lead, you'll work strategically with the business’ largest tradespartners to grow their business and maximise ROI on Checkatrade, while driving revenue through smarter product adoption. We’re looking for a true end to end relationship and revenue owner - you run and grow your book of business like its own p&l.

The job, unfiltered:

- Own a portfolio of high-value trade businesses end to end, and run a proactive outbound motion that grows revenue by getting them using and optimising the full Checkatrade suite.

- Build and run a clear monthly plan for every account, shaped by their goals, their data and the realities of their business.

- Influence decisions at every level, from owner to board, using performance data and a deep understanding of how trade businesses actually make money.

- Spot blockers before they cost revenue, then fix them. Design the processes and ways of working that make accounts run smoothly, so tradespeople can focus on growing.

- Build credible, high-trust relationships with senior stakeholders through regular contact and practical, strategic support. You’re their go-to commercial partner, not just their account manager.

The fit:

- A track record of managing and growing a significant book of revenue, with the results to prove it.

- A hybrid hunter/farmer mindset: hungry to achieve short-term revenue targets, while able to flex into building long-term strategic valued

- Real ownership of your portfolio, your performance and your commercial outcomes. You don’t wait to be told what to do next.

- Commercial credibility with senior decision-makers. You can challenge, advise and negotiate, and they listen.

- Resilience. When things don’t go to plan, you reset, adapt and keep moving.

- A collaborative, influential, people-first approach that makes people want to work with you, internally and externally.

- Confidence with CRM and AI tools, or the curiosity to pick them up fast and use them to work smarter.

- Adaptability and a willingness to learn quickly.

(Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.)

What you get

💰 Competitive salary, annual bonus & equity scheme

🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support

🚲 Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Scheme

🎂 Birthday/special day leave, buy & sell holiday scheme

❤️ 1 week's paid charity leave, and more

How this goes

- Screening call with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners

- 1st stage interview with the Head of Account Management

- 2nd stage interviews with senior stakeholders

- Final stage, including a case study presentation

Not this one? Stay close anyway. Join the Talent Community https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/checkatrade/form/register-interest and we'll ping you the second something better fits.

About us

We’re Checkatrade - the UK’s leading platform for finding a tradesperson. With more than 50,000 trades listed and over 6 million reviews, we help homeowners get jobs done right and help tradespeople grow their business.

We’re growing fast, with big plans to become the go-to brand for home improvements. If you care about great work, take pride in the details, and want to make an impact, you’ll fit right in.
